asr.full_text: So guys today were gonna be seeing on how we can get Uber gift cards from amazon and how we can actually use them in the uber app to pay for a ride So all you have to do is go to amazon first. Type in Uber gift card and this is the one you have to choose right here and when you select that you get the option of choosing what amount you want so you can choose 100 250, 500 and 1000 and I usually go for the 250 one so at checkout you have 7% off, so you get the 100 rupees 100 tokens at 93 250 at 235, 500 at 475 something and 1000 at 970 250 at 235 500 at 475 or something and thousand at 970 and There's discounts at checkout and you have to enter your email address here your name and Any message you wanna send it to yourself or maybe a friend and you can also choose quality and when you click buy now it takes you to the payment gateway and you choose the billing address and that's about it they send the code to your mail so now I will go to the mail and I will show you AmazonPay gift card is the mail that comes and you receive 500 uber gift card and what you need to do is go ahead and copy this voucher code right here and then you go to the Uber App. Open the Uber App. Go to the Payments Section and press Add Payment Method. Press Gift Card and you just paste the gift code right here. And you press save and then the uber credits get added to your payment method, and as you can see right here under gift cards i have 400 bucks so I can use that for my Uber rides or Uber Eats orders and I don't have to pay by cash and this is a much safer way of paying for the rides you don't have to pay by cash. And this is a much safer way of paying for your rides. Like you don't have to search for change or anything and you can just choose the cash option and still end up not paying cash. it just deducts from your the gift card credits that you have here. annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents a practical tutorial for buying an Uber e-gift card on Amazon and redeeming it for Uber rides or Uber Eats. The described steps show selecting a denomination, completing checkout, receiving a code by email, and entering it in Uber's payment section. The request for comments concerns viewer questions and is not tied to payment, credential handoff, investment returns, or off-platform participation.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central content is an ordinary commerce and service tutorial: purchasing an Uber gift card through Amazon and applying it as payment for Uber services. The evidence does not show a free-gift claim, credential request, investment return, recruitment structure, or paid earning guidance.
